ideas.label: Simplification
ideas.summary: Simplify when exchanges preserve your advantage and remove the opponent's active resources. Trading pieces is not automatically good just because you are ahead.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Maneuvering: The Art of Piece Play

ideas.label: Simplification
ideas.summary: Trade your bad minor piece for the opponent's good one, or exchange attackers when defending. Keep the pieces that can exploit the remaining pawn structure.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Maneuvering: The Art of Piece Play

ideas.label: Simplification
ideas.principle: Evaluate the exact ending before exchanging
ideas.summary: Before entering a pawn ending, verify king access, reserve tempi, and pawn breaks. A favorable-looking exchange can fail if the resulting isolated pawn is fixed or the opponent creates a distant passer.
